name: blip-raycast
title: Blip
description: Prepare complete file batches in Blip and open its Mac settings panes from Raycast.
author: itsdanielsultan

commands.name: send-to-blip
commands.title: Prepare Blip Transfer
commands.description: Choose multiple files or folders and open Blip's recipient picker. Does not send automatically.

commands.name: send-selected-finder-item
commands.title: Prepare Finder Selection in Blip
commands.description: Open Blip's recipient picker with every selected Finder item. Does not send automatically.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Blip Settings
commands.description: Open Blip's General, Devices, Profile or Help settings pane. Requires Accessibility.
